composed.area_scope: FF-only floor; excludes parallel syndrome trees, encoding, row mux/control, clock/hold/route. No fit claim.
composed.routing_tracks_status: Encoded648-bit frame replaces raw544/560 bit boundary; actual track/channel capacity must be bound by physicalowner
composed.latency_scope: Preserve phase/valid/retirement on fault-free path; correction stalls consume held reservations and must be measured, never modeled free

protocol.reserve: Reserve64 destination slots at actual accepted hub read; issue_v must imply hub protected-flight in_r and valid source ownership
protocol.retire: Return credit only on checked receiver row transfer into a reserved protected output; no return on ECC repair or uncorrectable row
protocol.CE: Suppress valid/grant/pop/return before action; bank performs protected five-edge repair; all relevant transaction state remains held
protocol.UE: Sticky dualrail fault quarantine; never silently erase outstanding reservations
protocol.reset: Cold common reset only with all encoded valid paths discarded; warm reset cannot fabricate completion or credits
protocol.encoded_chain: Encode at trusted producing register; carry original648/72bit code through transport, queue and held outputs. Decode/re-encode across an unprotected stored or transported boundary is forbidden.
protocol.current_reuse_gap: Existing protected_flight raw in/out ports require additive encoded-interface variant for this chain. Do not wire unstallable hub issue directly to elastic in_r, and do not claim current helper alone closes boundary protection.
